versions.content: The Ea module shall call the function defined in the configuration parameter EaNvMJobErrorNotification upon failure of an asynchronous block invalidation operation after performing all necessary internal management and error handling operations. Failure of an asynchronous block invalidation operation implies the block invalidation job is finished and has failed.
